raw.query: SELECT window_name, overprovision_vision_x_as_ingested, overprovision_vision_x_effective, overprovision_vision_x_is_superseded FROM provenance.grid_window_effective ORDER BY window_name;
raw.observed: Calm-traffic overprovision_vision_x peaks at 8 (steady24h, as_ingested) / 4 (effective, superseded); max across all windows is 8, none >10. Knee separation itself holds: sweep_curve head2k aic vision knee=32 (knee_censored=true, saturated_in_range=false) vs llm knee=2 → 16×.
raw.claimed: >10× separation under calibrated timing AND oversprovision of the encoder fleet by that (>10×) factor in calm traffic.
raw.evidence: The >10× KNEE SEPARATION is supported (head2k aic: vision 32 / llm 2 = 16×), but the realized calm-traffic encoder overprovision (overprovision_vision_x) is only 8× ingested / 4× effective (steady24h) and is flagged superseded; no window reaches >10×.
raw.fix: Keep the >10× as the head2k knee-separation statement (vision 32 / llm 2 = 16×, calibrated). For the encoder-fleet overprovision in calm traffic, report the measured figure (≤8× as-ingested, 4× effective) rather than '>10×', or explicitly label 16× as a knee-ratio (one-signal sizing) argument, not the realized fleet overprovision.
